bus_drain.basis: The stock firmware drains the bus with a discarded read of the first address past its DRAM map: helper 0x14c9130 (slot 1) and classifier 0x14c8f4c read 0x60000000, and the app memory map 0x2e24fb8 ends there (Linux 0x40000000+0x10000000, shared 0x50000000+0xff00000, rpmsg 0x5ff00000+0x100000).

xs20.dram_basis: The firmware memory map and the supplied Linux device tree (identical to X-T5 4.31's, SHA-256 9cb8691a..., mem=256M) end at 1.5 GiB; installed capacity is unmeasured.
